name: Value
description: Fundamentals relative to price.

name: Cheapness
description: Book equity, assets and sales relative to market value.

name: Earnings yield
description: Earnings, gross profit and intrinsic value relative to price.

name: Cash flow yield
description: Operating cash flow, free cash flow and cash-based operating profit relative to market value.

name: Dividend yield
description: Dividends relative to price, assets and earnings.

name: Equity duration
description: How far in the future expected cash flows arrive.

name: Profitability
description: How profitable the firm is.

name: Income profitability
description: Earnings-based profits relative to assets, equity, liabilities or PP&E.

name: Profit margins
description: Profits relative to sales or employees.

name: Cash flow profitability
description: Cash flow and cash-based operating profit relative to assets, equity, sales or debt.

name: Fundamental momentum
description: Recent improvement in fundamentals.

name: Profit growth
description: Changes in profits and profitability over one to five years.

name: Earnings surprise
description: Unexpected quarterly earnings and sales.

name: Earnings quality
description: How reliable reported earnings are.

name: Accruals
description: Gap between accounting earnings and cash flow.

name: Special items
description: Non-recurring and extraordinary items, which are mostly one-off charges.

name: Earnings persistence
description: How strongly earnings carry over from year to year.

name: Tax burden
description: Taxes relative to income.

name: Investment
description: Growth of the balance sheet and operations.

name: Asset growth
description: Growth in total, operating and long-lived assets, and the Stambaugh–Yuan management mispricing score.

name: Capex growth
description: Growth in capital expenditure.

name: Working capital growth
description: Growth in inventory, receivables and other working capital.

name: Operating payables growth
description: Growth in payables to suppliers, accrued expenses and taxes: liabilities that arise from operations.

name: Book equity growth
description: Growth in book equity.

name: Long-term investment growth
description: Growth in long-term investments.

name: Financial asset growth
description: Growth in short-term investments and financial assets.

name: Operating growth
description: Growth in sales, costs and employees.

name: Intangibles
description: Spending on intangible capital, such as R&D and advertising.

name: R&D intensity
description: R&D spending relative to assets, sales or price.

name: Advertising intensity
description: Advertising spending relative to sales.

name: Operating efficiency
description: How the firm uses its assets and labor.

name: Asset turnover
description: Sales and operating costs relative to assets.

name: Working capital efficiency
description: How quickly inventory, receivables and payables turn over.

name: Capital intensity
description: PP&E and capex relative to assets, price, profit or cash flow.

name: Labor intensity
description: Staff costs and sales per employee.

name: Labor productivity growth
description: Growth in sales per employee.

name: Issuance
description: Net capital raised from shareholders and creditors.

name: Equity issuance
description: Net share issuance, from market and accounting data.

name: Equity payout
description: Buybacks and total payout to shareholders.

name: Debt issuance
description: Net issuance and growth of debt.

name: Liability growth
description: Growth in total, current and non-current liabilities, including debt.

name: External financing
description: Total net financing from debt and equity.

name: Financial strength
description: Capital structure and financial strength.

name: Book leverage
description: Debt relative to book assets, book equity or book enterprise value.

name: Market leverage
description: Debt relative to market equity or market enterprise value.

name: Debt maturity
description: The share of debt and liabilities that is long-term.

name: Cost of debt
description: Interest expense relative to debt.

name: Preferred stock
description: Preferred stock outstanding and its growth.

name: Balance sheet liquidity
description: Cash and current assets relative to liabilities or assets.

name: Distress
description: Bankruptcy-risk and safety scores.

name: Financial constraints
description: Kaplan–Zingales index.

name: Low risk
description: Low return and earnings risk.

name: Volatility
description: Total and idiosyncratic return volatility.

name: Lottery
description: Largest daily returns over the past month.

name: Beta
description: Sensitivity to and correlation with the market.

name: Skewness
description: Asymmetry of daily returns.

name: Earnings volatility
description: Volatility of earnings and cash flow.

name: Size
description: Firm size, age and trading activity.

name: Firm size
description: Market value, book value, assets and sales.

name: Firm age
description: Months since the firm first appears in the data.

name: Share price
description: Share price level.

name: Illiquidity
description: How hard the stock is to trade: price impact, bid-ask spreads and low trading volume.

name: Share turnover
description: Share turnover and days without trading.

name: Short-term reversal
description: Last month's return, with the sign reversed.

name: Short-term reversal
description: Last month's return, with the sign reversed.

name: Momentum
description: Returns over the past two months to two years.

name: Momentum 2-6
description: Returns over windows of two to six months, with or without the last month.

name: Momentum 7-12
description: Returns over months 7-12.

name: Momentum 2-12
description: Returns over months 2-12 and similar windows of 9 to 24 months, and the 52-week high.

name: Long-term reversal
description: Returns over multi-year windows, up to 20 years back, with the sign reversed.

name: Long-term reversal
description: Returns over multi-year windows, up to 20 years back, with the sign reversed.

name: Seasonality
description: Returns in the same calendar month in past years.

name: Seasonality
description: Past returns in the same calendar month.

name: Quality
description: Scores that combine several signals of firm quality.

name: Quality
description: Quality minus junk, the Piotroski F-score and the Stambaugh–Yuan performance mispricing score, which combine profitability, safety, growth and momentum signals.
